purpose: Distinguish the historical LABEL_PERM wording from the frozen RANDOM_LABEL control, derive the scientific and resource consequences of alias, replacement or coexistence, and recommend an author-owned resolution. This audit does not amend authority, edit a frozen artifact, implement a control, execute a test, call an optimizer/evaluator or consume formal FFE.

evidence_inventory.observation: LABEL_PERM is described as permuting graph-node labels while preserving graph statistics and is a primary H1 comparator.
The frozen synthetic design defines truth-node membership and calls for random permutation of component labels with component sizes preserved.
RANDOM_LABEL randomizes community identity while preserving activation frequency and group-size distribution.
RANDOM_LABEL is a distinct result-schema value from I3, RAY_STYLE, DIV_MATCH and DEG_REWIRE, but the document does not relate it to LABEL_PERM.
The plan-level fairness record preserves the historical LABEL_PERM identifier.
The H1 decision branch still names label-permutation as a mechanism control.
The experiment matrix requires a label-permuted graph that preserves degree/edge-weight distributions while breaking community semantics.
The current recommended resource envelope assumes eight M variants and five C1 variants, which is compatible with alias/replacement but not coexistence.

component_id_renaming.operation: Apply a bijection only to component identifiers while keeping every constraint node in the same component and keeping residual coordinates aligned with that component.
component_id_renaming.mathematical_consequence: This is a coordinate renaming. A correctly permutation-equivariant implementation should produce the same donor identities and FFE ledger up to the renamed component coordinate.
component_id_renaming.risk_if_used_as_ablation: It may be a behavioral no-op and therefore cannot falsify a community-semantics contribution.

node_to_community_membership_shuffle.operation: Keep the learned activation decision, active-node set and component-size multiset, but randomly reassign active constraint nodes among component slots under a frozen domain-separated control RNG; residual coordinates remain tied to their original constraints.
node_to_community_membership_shuffle.destroyed_object: association between learned community membership and the physical/analytic constraint identity
required_boundaries: Reject or mark INAPPLICABLE any draw that does not change the node partition after the frozen attempt policy.
Use a domain-separated control RNG and record the permutation/provenance without consuming base-RNG draws.
Never permute ground-truth labels used only by offline NMI scoring.
Never use objective, constraint or evaluator callbacks to construct the control.
Report activation and group-size matching checks for every applicable checkpoint.

semantic_distinction.audit_inference_boundary: The second operation is the scientifically coherent interpretation of RANDOM_LABEL and of the historical intent to break constraint semantics. This is a static project analysis, not an author decision and not evidence that any current production code implements either operation.

findings.title: The historical LABEL_PERM wording does not distinguish a no-op identifier renaming from a membership-shuffling negative control
findings.consequence: Two conforming-looking implementations could yield different scientific tests; one may leave donor behavior unchanged while the other destroys the target semantics.
findings.required_resolution: Freeze an explicit typed relation and an operational definition before SA or S6-E0.

findings.title: H1, ABL-03, result schema and the frozen NV roster do not currently share one control identifier
findings.consequence: The same immutable results could be aggregated under different comparator families or schema keys.
findings.required_resolution: Version the H1/ABL/result-schema references without editing historical frozen bytes.

findings.title: The eight-variant internal resource envelope silently assumes alias or replacement
findings.consequence: Selecting coexistence adds at least one formal M variant and invalidates the current run/FFE total.
findings.required_resolution: Bind the author-selected relation before the final SA matrix and resource authorization.

decision_options.meaning: Preserve LABEL_PERM only as a historical frozen identifier. In a versioned amendment, replace it in future H1, ABL-03, result-schema and adapter contracts with RANDOM_LABEL, defined as a nonidentity node-to-community membership shuffle. Reclassify pure component-ID renaming as a zero-FFE permutation-equivariance integrity test.
decision_options.scientific_rationale: This preserves the original negative-control intent, removes the no-op ambiguity, matches the frozen NV roster and avoids adding a redundant formal variant.
decision_options.resource_effect: Keeps the currently audited Ray-inclusive internal matrix at M=8 variants and C1=5 variants.

decision_options.meaning: Declare LABEL_PERM and RANDOM_LABEL exact aliases for the same membership-shuffle operation.
decision_options.scientific_risk: The old wording remains capable of being misread as identifier renaming unless every operational clause is superseded; aliasing also obscures version provenance.
decision_options.resource_effect: Same arithmetic as the recommended option.

decision_options.meaning: Keep both as distinct formal M variants, with LABEL_PERM separately operationalized and RANDOM_LABEL used as the membership-shuffle control.
decision_options.scientific_risk: A scientifically useful distinct LABEL_PERM operation is not currently specified; mere component-ID renaming would be a no-op rather than a valid ablation.
decision_options.resource_effect: Adds 360 M run packages and 7,560,000 FFE over the recommended matrix before any optional C1 placement.

decision_options.meaning: Do not choose a relation. BM-R1 may remain independently selectable, but SA and S6-E0 remain blocked.

calculation_basis.M: 12 synthetic problems, frozen dimension sum 126, 30 seeds, 2,000D per run
calculation_basis.C1: 16 CEC2006 eligible problems, frozen dimension sum 159, 30 seeds, 10,000D per run
calculation_basis.F: 8 fallback problems, 2 variants, 30 seeds, frozen aggregate 26,400,000 FFE
calculation_basis.boundary: These are plan arithmetic only. No run package or FFE was created.

required_future_amendment_scope: Define RANDOM_LABEL as nonidentity node-to-community membership shuffling, not component-ID renaming.
Supersede only future H1, ABL-03, result-schema, adapter and resource references; preserve all historical frozen bytes.
Add a deterministic component-ID-renaming equivariance contract that consumes no evaluator calls and no formal FFE.
Add expected-red contracts for nonidentity, group-size preservation, activation matching, domain-separated RNG, forbidden ground-truth access and exact FFE neutrality.
Keep BM-R1 parameter selection independent and keep SA/S6-E0 held until the identity amendment is separately frozen and restored.
